light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music. The garage door is wide open and plenty of grey daylight comes in, plus the ceiling tube is on: the workshop is well lit and his face is clearly lit.

clips.text: Ahora, la herramienta. Esto es un cautín, un soldador de estaño común, de sesenta a cien vatios.
clips.action: he lifts a pencil-type soldering iron with a flat spade tip from its stand and shows it to the camera. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Le cambio la punta por una plana, tipo paleta, y esa punta queda solo para plástico.
clips.d1: close view: the plain pointed tip of a soldering iron is unscrewed by gloved fingers
clips.d2: a flat spade-shaped tip is screwed in its place

clips.text: Si no tienes cautín, sirve una pistola de calor, la de decapar. Es más lenta y calienta más alrededor.
clips.action: he holds the iron in one hand and a hot air gun in the other, comparing them. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Con el cautín controlas mejor dónde derrites. Por eso lo prefiero.
clips.action: he puts the heat gun down and points the iron at the camera like a pen, teaching. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Y los dos dólares son esto: un retazo de malla, un poco de alcohol y una broca fina. El plástico sale gratis de un bidón viejo.
clips.action: he lines up on the bench a small piece of mesh, a small bottle of alcohol and a thin drill bit, counting them with a finger. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Si no tienes el cautín, esa es la única compra de verdad. Pero te queda para siempre, y con él arreglas baldes,
clips.action: he lifts the iron again, honest shrug. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.
he lifts the iron again, honest shrug. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Si el tuyo tiene perilla de temperatura, empieza bajo y ve subiendo de a poco, hasta que el plástico brille sin humear.
clips.action: he turns a small dial on the soldering station base, watching the tip. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: ¿Y con un encendedor o una vela? No. El plástico se quema por arriba,
clips.action: he holds up a cheap plastic lighter and a candle stub, then puts them away firmly. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: se llena de hollín y queda crudo abajo. Y el hollín no deja que se mezcle.
clips.action: he holds up a cheap plastic lighter and a candle stub, then puts them away firmly. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Antes de tocar el tanque, practica en un pedazo que no te importe.
clips.action: he taps a scrap of black plastic on the bench with the iron, cable hanging. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Si el plástico humea mucho o hace burbujas, está demasiado caliente. Así se agujerea.
clips.d1: close view: the hot flat tip touches the black scrap and the plastic around it turns glossy and soft
clips.d2: the tip is pressed a bit too long: the plastic bubbles and a small hole appears, a thin plume of smoke

clips.text: Tiene que ponerse brillante, como mojado, sin burbujas. Ese es el punto.
clips.d1: close view: the tip moves slowly, making the surface glossy and wet-looking without bubbles
clips.d2: a shallow smooth glossy puddle of plastic, no smoke

clips.text: Y el humo del plástico no se respira. Hazlo al aire libre o con la puerta abierta, y aléjate de la cara.
clips.action: he walks to the wide-open garage door and points outside at the street and the open air. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.

clips.text: Si tu tanque está arriba, en el techo: lo vacías, escalera firme, y entre dos. Mejor bajarlo.
clips.action: he stands at the bench with his hands resting on it, speaking slowly and seriously. He speaks naturally to the friend holding the camera, with small natural gestures.
